title: The Golden Cosmic Architecture
subtitle: The Firmament Vaulted Dome of the Earth
author: Acuity Institute
description: Sets out the ancient Hebrew three-tiered cosmology—earth on pillars, a solid firmament (raqia) and the divine throne above—contrasting it with a heliocentric worldview and relating it to tabernacle and temple architecture. A modern research presentation from the Acuity Institute collection.
